summary:
Iteration 3 testing (Google sign-in + shared household ledger + needs/wants + receipt vision + language toggle + themes). BACKEND: 22/22 new pytest tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_household_auth.py covering: (a) Auth — /api/auth/me 401 without token, 200 with Bearer test_session_owner (returns household_id); POST /api/auth/session with invalid session_id → 401; POST /api/auth/logout requires auth. (b) Household — GET /api/household returns name + 6-letter invite_code + users list; POST /api/household creates and returns invite_code (6 letters), rejects double-create 400; POST /api/household/join with bad code → 404; data isolation verified: outsider (new household) cannot GET or DELETE the owner-household's expense (DELETE → 404); member in same household sees owner's expenses; endpoints /household, /summary, /expenses, /bills, /udhaar, /report all return 403 for a user with household_id=null. (c) Expenses — POST returns spend_level + need_type keys; PATCH /api/expenses/{id} toggles need_type between 'need'/'want'; bad enum → 422; unknown id → 404; GET /api/expenses?month=YYYY-MM filters correctly; PATCH requires auth → 401. (d) Report — GET /api/report includes by_need breakdown with 'need' and 'want' keys after seeded data. (e) Parse — source='text' lang='en' with 'Spent 500 rupees on petrol' returns amount=500, is_spend=true, note contains only ASCII (English). SMS with 'OTP' correctly classifies as otp (is_spend=false); 'Rs. 20000 credited... salary' → is_spend=false, sms_kind=received. (f) Receipt vision — generated real PNG receipt via PIL (Al-Fatah grocery items + grand total 1100 PKR) → POST /api/receipt returns amount in (1100, 1050), category grocery/milk_veg/other, non-empty note; /api/receipt without auth → 401; image_base64 shorter than 100 chars → 422. Zero leftover TEST_ users/sessions/households post-run; owner+member still in Amna ka ghar.

FRONTEND (390x844): Login screen renders [data-testid=google-signin-button] and [data-testid=login-language-toggle] which switches Urdu↔English (title changes from 'گھر کھاتہ' to 'Ghar Khata'). After setting localStorage session_token='test_session_owner' and reload: home shows household name 'Amna ka ghar' and today-left/spent cards, [data-testid=need-toggle-<id>] pill present on ExpenseRow and TOGGLES correctly (Want → Need). Add-expense modal: [data-testid=receipt-camera-button] and [data-testid=receipt-library-button] both render. Report tab: report-total-card, report-need-want, share-report-button all present. Household setup screen (orphan user seeded via Mongo): household-name-input, create-household-button, invite-code-input, join-household-button all render; entering 'ZZZZZZ' + join → [data-testid=household-error] shows 'شامل نہیں ہو سکے'. Joining with real code 'YRHXJP' transitions user to app (orphan test session cleaned up afterward).

BUG FOUND — Settings screen stuck on loading spinner (invite-card, language toggles, theme pills, signout button never render) due to auth race condition in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx (see rca_of_issue).

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /settings often shows a permanent ActivityIndicator — invite-card, invite-code-text, share-invite-button, language-ur, language-en, theme-paper/night/mehndi/gulabi, signout-button, share-app-button, leave-household-button NEVER render. Only save-settings-button (sticky footer, unconditional) is visible. Reproduces reliably on web preview after cold localStorage.setItem + reload.

integration_issues.issue: React Query useQuery(['household']) and useQuery(['summary']) fire BEFORE AuthProvider's async useEffect calls setToken(saved) — all /api/household and /api/summary requests go out with EMPTY Authorization header and get 401. Only /api/auth/me is observed with 'Bearer test_session_owner'. Because api.ts req() only calls onUnauthorized() when token is truthy, the 401 is silently swallowed and the settings screen never recovers (q.isLoading stays true via retries). Home sometimes shows cached data from a later retry, but settings is deterministically broken.

action_items: Fix the auth-token race in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx so React Query queries don't fire before setToken runs. Options: (a) gate the Providers' children on `user !== undefined` (show splash until auth bootstrap completes); (b) attach the token synchronously via a localStorage/SecureStore read at module scope before AuthProvider mounts (web can read localStorage sync); (c) invalidate react-query cache after setToken so pending/errored queries refetch; (d) in api.ts req(), also call onUnauthorized() for 401 even when token is null so the UI can trigger an auth re-check. Minimum repro: localStorage.clear(); localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('test_session_owner')); reload; navigate to /settings → spinner forever, invite-card never rendered.

After the fix, re-verify the full settings flow: invite code displayed (YRHXJP), language-en switches whole UI to English/LTR, 4 themes change colors, share-invite-button opens share sheet, signout-button returns to login.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts line 46-47: `if (res.status === 401 && token) onUnauthorized();` — the `&& token` guard means 401s during the pre-auth window are silently absorbed. Consider firing onUnauthorized on any 401, or better, delay queries until a known-auth state exists.

auth.tsx line 73-83: Token loading is async (storage.secureGet). While this runs, child components already mount and their useQuery hooks fire with no auth header. Pattern: render null/splash while `user === undefined` (initial), separate from `user === null` (signed out).

settings.tsx line 73: Showing ActivityIndicator while q.isLoading means a failed/retrying household query leaves the user with a permanently empty settings page. Should fall back to error state with retry button after a failure, not an indefinite loader.
server.py now at 683 lines — still under 700-line guideline; splitting into routers (auth / household / expenses / parse) would help maintainability as more features ship.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — login, home, need-toggle, add-expense receipt buttons, report, household setup+bad-code all work; settings screen blocked by auth race

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create & delete TEST_ expenses, TEST_Outsider_Home household (owned by TEST_outsider user), and two Mongo-seeded sessions (TEST_orphan_*, TEST_outsider_*) — all removed in fixture teardown. UI test also seeded a temporary orphan session 'test_session_orphan_ui' which was deleted after the household-setup flow completed. Owner+member users remain in 'Amna ka ghar' (invite code YRHXJP) as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green — reuse /app/backend/tests/test_household_auth.py (depends on PIL for the receipt test; `pip install pillow`). Frontend bug: open /settings via [data-testid=open-settings-button] after setting localStorage session_token — observe permanent ActivityIndicator and 401s on /api/household in network. Fix should make invite-card render immediately with the 6-letter code (test_session_owner → YRHXJP).
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Auth bootstrap race. /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx reads the stored session_token asynchronously inside a useEffect, then calls setToken(saved). Meanwhile, the rest of the tree (SettingsScreen among others) has already mounted and its `useQuery({queryKey:['household'], queryFn: api.household})` has already fired. Because api.ts's req() reads the module-level token and that token is still null, the request leaves without an Authorization header → backend returns 401 (verified via Playwright request interception: /api/household and /api/summary observed with empty auth header; only /api/auth/me carries 'Bearer test_session_owner'). api.ts req() guards onUnauthorized() behind `token != null`, so no auth-recovery is triggered. React Query keeps retrying; the settings UI's `q.isLoading ? <ActivityIndicator/> : (...)` branch keeps the user on the spinner, so invite-card, language-ur/en, theme-* and signout never render. REPRO: 1) localStorage.clear(); 2) localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('test_session_owner')); 3) reload; 4) click [data-testid=open-settings-button]; 5) observe spinner forever (screenshot /tmp/settings_cold.png). MITIGATION OPTIONS: (a) In AuthProvider, render a splash until the stored-token read completes (gate on `user === undefined`). (b) At module load in api.ts, synchronously read localStorage on web and seed the token so the first req() already has it. (c) After setToken(), call queryClient.invalidateQueries() so pending/failed queries refetch with the correct header. (d) Remove the `&& token` guard in req()'s 401 handler so the global handler can at least surface the issue.
